items.title: NCCE concludes 2-day training on lobbying and advocacy in CRR North
items.summary: By Olimatou Coker The National Council for Civic Education [NCCE] has concluded a 2-day capacity-building training on lobbying and advocacy in Central River Region North. The training was organised in collaboration with the Association of Non-Governmental Organisations [TANGO]...
